about: Gate 239 runs the review's content invariants over every ply of 39 of his own games (gates/fixtures/kunal/kunal-40.pgn, engine output recorded in kunal-40-evals.json and seeded back, grading live in the bundle): C1 no ply offers the played move as its own alternative (TC-R421), C2 every named move legal where named (TC-R422), C3 the standing clause agrees with the recorded engine number (TC-R423), C4 each side's counts sum to its moves (TC-R424). One geometry, kunal761. NOT COVERED: a change to the engine (re-record the fixture); game 29, which never finishes its review (named in the fixture); the refutation search a Brilliant waits for.

breaks.name: the-runner-up-may-be-the-played-move
breaks.why: the #420 guard is removed from sfGradePly's altSan, so where the engine's second choice is the move he played the review offers that move as its own alternative - the defect he found on his phone, which the Opera Game never visits
